comments.story: Lapsus$: GTA 6 hacker handed indefinite hospital order
comments.why: Interesting look at valuing human life.
comments.text: Seem to me like the prosecution is irrationally scared of something they don't understand. When personal data is leaked, no one gives a shit. I got downvoted to smithereens for commenting on HN that I thought the post about Steve Wozniac being in the hospital was perverted. But if you leak something from a business, then life in prison? People value their life at about $10m. There's a video I found interesting on a YT channel called practical engineering. [VIDEO] .
